title: Concept: Dependency marked optional at the root
description: pom.xml declares an optional dependency that no consumer inherits, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an optional dependency that no consumer inherits.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an optional dependency that no consumer inherits.
